ledger: Group: colored plastic balls in glass bowl (red/yellow/green), child's hands manipulating them; extra red/green balls lie on the table at the right edge, out of reach.
00:00.00 (sharp): bowl holds 8 balls = 3 green, 3 yellow, 2 red; child's hands raised above bowl, no ball visibly held.
00:00.25: hands enter bowl; bowl still shows 2 red, 3 yellow, 3 green (one red partly under fingers).
00:00.75: child lifts a red ball out of the bowl, yet the bowl still shows 2 red, 3 yellow, 3 green underneath -> total 9 (3 red) with no visible ball added.
00:01.00-00:02.00 (sharp): held red + bowl 2 red, 3 yellow, 3 green = 9 total; table balls at right edge unchanged.
00:02.25-00:03.00: held red returned into bowl; partially hand-occluded; consistent with 3R/3Y/3G = 9.
00:03.00-00:04.75: camera pushes in; visible ~3 yellow, 3 green, 2-3 red, some under hand (occlusion, not disappearance).
00:05.00-00:06.00: stirring with heavy motion blur; counts not reliable (blur).
00:06.75 (semi-sharp): reds visibly increase (~3-4 red), yellow reduced to ~1-2 visible.
00:07.75 (semi-sharp): ~5 red, 1 green, 1-2 yellow visible; nothing added from outside the bowl, no ball carried in.
00:09.25-00:09.75: ~5-6 red, 2 green, 1 yellow visible; balls look deformed/blobby (partly motion blur).
Net: red rises from 3 to ~5-6 and yellow falls from 3 to ~1 with no balls added or removed; only cause visible is stirring.

findings.description: At 00:00.00 the bowl holds 8 balls (2 red, 3 yellow, 3 green) and the child's hands appear empty. By 00:00.75-00:01.00 the child holds a red ball lifted from the bowl, but the bowl still contains 2 red, 3 yellow, 3 green, so the total jumps from 8 to 9 with no ball visibly added from the table or a hand.

findings.entity: red and yellow balls in bowl
findings.invariant_violated: per-color counts change without add/remove (kind transformation)
findings.description: Before stirring the bowl holds 3 red, 3 yellow and 3 green balls. During stirring (00:06.75-00:09.75) no ball enters or leaves the bowl, yet up to ~5-6 distinct red balls appear (sharp-ish reds at 00:07.75 and 00:09.50) while yellows drop to ~1. Yellow balls appear to have become red, or reds have multiplied, with no mechanism.
